rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comprehending words, facts, or what someone means, including understanding someone's feelings or intentions.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this for knowing how to do something or being able to handle it properly, as in knowing how to complete an assignment.

example.english: I understand how to do this assignment.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 ngo5 sik1 zou6

rows.note: Choose this when understanding means knowing a person's character or motives, or knowing the causes behind events.

example.english: I want to understand why he did that.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 liu5 gaai2 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zou6

rows.note: Use this when stating an inferred or interpreted understanding rather than directly knowing the meaning.

example.english: I understand that you may have your own reasons.
example.traditional: 我理解你可能有自己嘅苦衷。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lei5 gaai2 nei5 ho2 nang4 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 fu2 zung1
